domain_label: Sweater Vertical — Unit-Economics Viability Verdict & Go/No-Go
purpose: A method for delivering the blunt viability verdict on the AI-designed D2C knitwear brand (Ludhiana yarn -> manufacture/QC/finishing -> California/Turlock D2C, 3-article line A1 cotton-blend core / A2 fine-acrylic value / A3 merino-lambswool premium): converting the landed-cost stack and the contribution-after-CAC P&L into a single go/no-go call, stating why the venture is VIABLE only as a premium/community brand led by A3 plus bundles at blended CAC under ~$35 from organic/community/affiliate acquisition and NOT viable as an affordable-acrylic value-led cold-paid-social brand, naming leading-with-A2 as the most dangerous upstream mistake, surfacing the working-capital trap (dye-lot MOQ + ocean lead time + returns settlement) as the unmodelled killer that sinks a per-order-profitable brand, flagging that the viability spine is governing-yet-softest and single-analyst, ranking the single $1-2k live ad test (and the cheaper 60-90-day organic-traction probe) as the highest-leverage data acquisition, carrying Analyst-C's cross-examination (real repeat ~1.2x, returns 25-30%) so the verdict is qualified not merely asserted, and handing an explicit go/no-go-conditions and flip-conditions table to T10's decision memo. Every money/market/legal/duty/CAC claim is tagged FACT, ESTIMATE (method+basis+confidence), or UNKNOWN; coverage is a floor.
assumptions: this KB is the viability-verdict synthesis layer; it consumes the landed-cost stack (kb1, Analyst-A) and the contribution-after-CAC P&L (kb2, Analyst-B) and is cross-examined by analyst_c_viability_challenge.md, and it does not re-derive landed COGS
every dollar, CAC, returns, repeat, conversion, duty and price-band figure is a labeled estimate or a cited public fact, never a stated actual for a business that does not yet exist
US sweater duty rates are FACT: cotton 6110.20.20 ~16.5%, wool 6110.11 ~16%, acrylic/MMF 6110.30.30 ~32% (the discredited cotton ~7% is corrected and never used)
de-minimis duty-free entry under $800 is dead (EO 14324, effective Aug 29 2025), so the operating model is forced to bulk Importer-of-Record -> California 3PL -> domestic ship

the India surcharge is modelled as a 0-15% band (central ~10%) plus an explicit 25-50% spike scenario (the 50% peak was realised Aug 2025), forward level UNKNOWN with a Section 122 ~Jul-2026 sunset and a pending Section 301 replacement risk on the launch window

the contribution/CAC/returns/repeat spine is single-analyst (Analyst-B) and was cross-examined by Analyst-C; the verdict is kept in direction and qualified in confidence, using real repeat ~1.2x and returns 25-30% where Analyst-C corrected Analyst-B

the single highest-leverage data acquisition is a live blended-CAC reading; the $1-2k paid-ad test falsifies the value/paid disaster case while a $0-500 60-90-day organic-traction probe tests the founder-content-edge the GO condition actually rests on
exclusions: the per-unit landed-cost build (freight/MPF/HMF/broker/bond/IOR mechanics) -- owned by the landed-cost KB (kb1)
the full per-article contribution-after-CAC line-item P&L derivation -- owned by the D2C P&L KB (kb2)
yarn, machine, manufacturing-economics, QC and finishing cost detail -- owned by the upstream T1-T6 specialists
the AI-design creative pipeline and tech-pack execution -- owned by the design specialist (T8)
the final cross-vertical decision memo and macro neutralization -- owned by T10

glossary.definition: The blunt go/no-go call this KB exists to deliver: VIABLE only as a small premium/community brand led by A3 plus bundles acquiring customers at blended CAC under ~$35 from organic/community/affiliate channels; NOT viable as an affordable-acrylic, value-led, cold-paid-social brand. A labeled estimate on its soft demand spine, FACT-anchored on duty and de-minimis.

Price minus all variable costs (landed COGS + payment fees + outbound ship + returns reserve + customer-acquisition cost); the glossary's binding D2C viability metric (LTV:CAC > ~3), and the number on which the whole verdict turns -- distinct from gross margin over landed COGS.

The vanity 80-86% gross margin over landed COGS that looks fantastic and misleads, because it omits CAC, returns, payment fees and outbound ship -- the four costs below gross that decide survival and turn the value article into the biggest loss-maker.

The finding that the 32% MMF duty on acrylic (vs cotton 16.5% / wool 16%) erases acrylic's factory-gate cost lead at the US border, re-ranking factory-gate A2<A1<A3 into landed A1~=A2<A3, with cotton (A1) the cost-and-duty-friendly anchor.

The fact that realistic new-cohort 2025-26 apparel CAC ($45-70) is the same order of magnitude as the entire gross margin, so customer-acquisition cost -- not factory cost -- governs survival; the GO condition requires holding blended CAC under ~$35 via mostly-non-paid acquisition.

The single most dangerous move the upstream value-led plan invites: making the $55 fine-acrylic A2 the standalone hero on cold paid social, which loses money on the first order because its landed cost is not meaningfully below cotton (32% duty) and it carries a full CAC against the lowest price ceiling.

Because CAC and outbound shipping are charged per order, bundling amortises one CAC and one ship over a bigger basket; a 2-unit ~$130 bundle survives CAC to ~$69, so the required ~$120-150 AOV (an A3 unit or a 2-piece bundle) is the central pricing instruction that makes the line close.

The unmodelled killer: dye-lot MOQ (500+ units/colour of cash out) + ocean lead time + sell-through + returns settlement strand cash for months before it returns, so a per-order-profitable brand can still die on cash timing -- per-order viability is necessary, not sufficient.

The flag that the entire CAC/returns/contribution/break-even spine is single-analyst (Analyst-B), un-cross-examined by Analyst-A, and simultaneously the governing terms and the softest -- all ESTIMATE -- so a single live ad/organic test would harden or collapse the biggest uncertainty in the venture.

Analyst-C's most material correction: live apparel DTC effective repeat is ~1.2x (median second-order ~18.8%/365d, apparel ~15-17%), not the 1.5-2.5x assumed; this pulls A3's 3:1-clearing CAC from ~$69 to ~$33, so even A3-led requires organic-cheap acquisition.

nodes.definition: The formula node that recomputes break-even order volume as orders_per_month = fixed_monthly_nut / contribution_per_order. Worked recompute: at $3,000 nut and a realistic ~$20/order contribution (premium-led, bundle-heavy, CAC ~$45) -> 3,000/20 = 150 orders/mo (~$20-25k revenue/mo); at $1,500 nut -> 75; at $6,000 -> 300. Recompute table: nut/contribution -> orders = {1500/10=150, 1500/20=75, 1500/30=50; 3000/10=300, 3000/20=150, 3000/30=100; 6000/10=600, 6000/20=300, 6000/30=200}.

the flip-conditions name the evidence that would move the one-line verdict either way
the optimistic flips (above-median repeat, best-quartile CAC) are the cross-exam's reopened bull levers
the organic-probe outcome is the highest-information optimistic-or-pessimistic flip
the 80-86% gross-margin trap pulls toward an over-optimistic verdict that contribution-after-CAC must override
edges.resolution_rule: the verdict is set by contribution after CAC, never by gross margin; an 80-86% gross figure may not be cited as evidence of viability and is labeled a vanity number

edges.why_related: the bundle lever says A2 can ride a paying basket while the danger node says A2 loses money, pulling opposite ways on A2's role
edges.resolution_rule: A2 is dead only as a standalone $55 hero on cold paid; it is viable solely as a bundle-filler at an effective ~$65 unit inside an AOV >= ~$120 basket, never as a standalone lead

edges.why_related: the hand-off packages the conditions table for T10's decision memo
the hand-off carries the flip-conditions as the evidence that would change T10's call
the hand-off carries the HIGH legal flags into the decision memo unwaved
the hand-off expresses every figure under the FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN discipline
the review loop watches the inputs to the conditions and re-fires them when they change
a live-CAC, surcharge, returns or funding event sends the analysis back to re-issue the verdict

conflict_axes.name: gross_margin_vs_contribution_after_cac
conflict_axes.description: The 80-86% gross margin over landed COGS reads as comfortable viability while contribution after CAC shows the value article loses money, so the two metrics point to opposite verdicts.
poles: read viability off contribution after CAC
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: contribution after CAC is the binding metric; gross margin is a vanity number that may not be cited as evidence of viability

conflict_axes.name: factory_cost_vs_cac_as_governor
conflict_axes.description: The upstream chain optimises factory/landed cost while the verdict shows CAC ($45-70, ~gross-margin magnitude) governs survival, so cost-side and demand-side levers compete for primacy.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: CAC governs; factory cost is necessary but the verdict closes only when blended CAC is held under ~$35 via mostly-non-paid acquisition

conflict_axes.name: lead_a2_value_vs_lead_a3_premium
conflict_axes.description: The upstream line plan invites leading with the $55 A2 value article while the economics only close leading with A3 premium plus bundles, a direct line-strategy conflict.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: invert the upstream plan: lead A3 + bundles, confine A2 to a bundle-filler, never a standalone hero

conflict_axes.name: a2_standalone_dead_vs_a2_in_bundles_viable
conflict_axes.description: A2 loses money as a standalone $55 single yet can ride a paying ~$130 bundle, so 'A2 is dead' and 'A2 can work' are both partly true depending on packaging.
poles: A2 is viable as a bundle component
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: A2 is dead as a standalone hero on cold paid and viable only as a bundle-filler at an effective ~$65 unit inside an AOV >= ~$120 basket

conflict_axes.name: optimistic_repeat_vs_real_repeat
conflict_axes.description: Analyst-B's 1.5-2.5x repeat clears A3 at a $69 CAC while Analyst-C's real ~1.2x repeat pulls A3's clearing CAC to ~$33, a load-bearing parameter conflict.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: use the cited real ~1.2x repeat; A3's true 3:1-clearing CAC is ~$33, so even A3-led needs organic-cheap acquisition until a first cohort proves higher repeat

conflict_axes.name: per_order_profit_vs_cash_cycle_solvency
conflict_axes.description: A clean per-order contribution P&L reads as viable while the months-long dye-lot-MOQ + ocean + returns cash-out can bankrupt the same brand, so per-order and cash-timing views diverge.
poles: judge viability on the cash cycle
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: per-order viability is necessary not sufficient; the verdict is conditional on funding the working-capital cycle through the organic ramp

conflict_axes.name: paid_ad_test_vs_organic_traction_probe
conflict_axes.description: The $1-2k paid-ad test prices the channel the verdict says NOT to use while the cheaper organic probe tests the channel the GO condition rests on, so the two tests compete for primacy.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: run both before any bulk PO; the paid test falsifies the value/paid disaster case, but the organic probe is the higher-information test of the founder-content-edge

conflict_axes.name: current_low_surcharge_vs_spike_recurrence
conflict_axes.description: Planning on today's ~10% India surcharge versus stress-testing a return to the realised 25-50% peak pulls landed-COGS assumptions in opposite directions on the launch window.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: model the central ~10% band but require the venture to survive a 25-50% spike; re-confirm the rate at every PO and never harden a forward number

conflict_axes.name: blunt_decisiveness_vs_honest_hedging
conflict_axes.description: A blunt one-line verdict is actionable but can overclaim certainty the un-cross-examined demand spine does not support, while heavy tagging protects honesty but reads as hedged.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: give the blunt direction (premium/organic survives, value/paid dies) but carry the least-bad/cash-fragile qualification and FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN tags so it stays auditable

edge_cases.description: The 80-86% gross margin over landed COGS is quoted as the venture's profitability
edge_cases.trigger: gross margin over landed COGS is cited as evidence of viability
edge_cases.mitigation: label the 80-86% gross a vanity number and require the verdict to rest on contribution after CAC

edge_cases.description: A2 acrylic is led with as the standalone $55 value hero on cold paid social
edge_cases.trigger: the value-led line plan makes A2 the lead article on paid social
edge_cases.mitigation: name leading-with-A2 the most dangerous mistake; confine A2 to a bundle-filler at an effective ~$65 unit, never a standalone hero

edge_cases.description: A3's 3:1-clearing CAC is taken as ~$69 using the optimistic 1.5-2.5x repeat
edge_cases.trigger: the LTV:CAC gate is run on Analyst-B's repeat assumption
edge_cases.mitigation: use real repeat ~1.2x; A3's clearing CAC is ~$33, so even A3-led requires organic-cheap acquisition

edge_cases.description: Viability is concluded from a clean per-order contribution P&L while ignoring the cash cycle
edge_cases.trigger: a per-order-positive P&L is read as proof of solvency
edge_cases.mitigation: treat per-order viability as necessary not sufficient and make funding the working-capital cycle a binding GO condition

edge_cases.description: The $35 blended-CAC bar is read as a launch dial rather than a 12-18-month organic engine built
edge_cases.trigger: the GO condition's CAC threshold is set as if achievable at launch
edge_cases.mitigation: reframe under-$35 CAC as a built organic stock, not a flow bought at launch; the governing variable is the founder-content-edge

edge_cases.description: Only the $1-2k paid-ad test is run and a $55 paid CAC is read as validating the organic-led brand
edge_cases.trigger: the paid test result is generalised to the organic channel the verdict rests on
edge_cases.mitigation: run the $0-500 organic-traction probe too; a paid CAC says nothing about the organic engine; both before the bulk PO

edge_cases.description: Landed COGS is planned on today's ~10% surcharge with no spike stress-test
edge_cases.trigger: the surcharge is hardened at ~10% for the launch-window PO
edge_cases.mitigation: stress-test a 25-50% spike (realised Aug 2025) and re-confirm the rate at every PO; keep the forward level UNKNOWN

edge_cases.description: A supplier under-blends a 'cotton' sweater past 50% MMF and the brand-as-IOR mis-declares duty
edge_cases.trigger: a blend ratio drifts across the chief-weight threshold without a PO check
edge_cases.mitigation: write blend % +/- tolerance + a fibre-composition/duty-classification check into every PO

edge_cases.trigger: a naming/likeness or creator campaign uses a recognizable person without a license
edge_cases.mitigation: clear marks/likenesses before printing or any creator post; the AI-design angle does not launder a likeness and creators inherit the risk

edge_cases.description: The bulk inventory PO is committed before either the paid test or the organic probe reads
edge_cases.trigger: the cash-stranding bulk buy precedes the demand signal
edge_cases.mitigation: sequence both cheap tests before the bulk-inventory commitment that triggers the cash trap

edge_cases.description: A single break-even order count is quoted without its sensitivity to CAC/contribution drift
edge_cases.trigger: the break-even figure is read as a comfortable margin
edge_cases.mitigation: show the recompute grid and the doubling to 300+ orders/mo when contribution halves on CAC drift

edge_cases.trigger: the GO half is relayed without the cross-exam qualification and binding unknowns
edge_cases.mitigation: hand off GO-only-qualified with the live-CAC governing unknown, the repeat ~1.2x correction, and the working-capital point of death

dominance_rules.rule: Contribution after CAC dominates gross margin in any viability call
dominance_rules.rationale: gross margin over landed COGS omits the four below-gross costs that decide survival
dominance_rules.trigger: a viability claim is made on gross margin
dominance_rules.action: override it with the contribution-after-CAC read and label the gross figure a vanity number

dominance_rules.rule: CAC dominates factory cost as the governing survival term
dominance_rules.rationale: realistic CAC ($45-70) is the same magnitude as the whole gross margin while factory cost is a fraction of it
dominance_rules.trigger: viability is argued from optimised factory/landed cost
dominance_rules.action: require blended CAC under ~$35 via mostly-non-paid acquisition before any GO

dominance_rules.rule: A3-premium + bundles dominates A2-value as the line lead
dominance_rules.rationale: only A3 + bundles show positive contribution at realistic CAC and clear LTV:CAC
dominance_rules.trigger: the plan proposes leading with A2 value on paid social
dominance_rules.action: invert the line: lead A3 + bundles, confine A2 to a bundle-filler

dominance_rules.rule: Real repeat (~1.2x) dominates the optimistic 1.5-2.5x assumption
dominance_rules.rationale: cited apparel DTC repeat is ~1.2x and is load-bearing for even A3's LTV:CAC
dominance_rules.action: re-run with ~1.2x; A3's 3:1-clearing CAC is ~$33, so even A3-led needs organic-cheap CAC

dominance_rules.rule: The working-capital cash cycle dominates a clean per-order P&L
dominance_rules.rationale: a per-order-profitable brand can die on the months-long dye-lot-MOQ + ocean + returns cash-out
dominance_rules.trigger: viability is concluded from per-order contribution alone
dominance_rules.action: make funding the working-capital cycle through the organic ramp a binding GO condition

dominance_rules.rule: The organic-traction probe dominates the paid-ad test as the validating evidence
dominance_rules.rationale: the verdict rests on the organic channel, which the paid test does not interrogate
dominance_rules.trigger: a paid CAC reading is used to validate the organic-led brand
dominance_rules.action: require the $0-500 organic probe to read before any GO, alongside the paid test as disaster-case falsifier

dominance_rules.rule: A 25-50% surcharge stress-test dominates the current ~10% in the launch-window plan
dominance_rules.rationale: the 50% peak was realised and a 301 replacement could land on the launch window
dominance_rules.trigger: landed COGS is hardened at ~10% surcharge
dominance_rules.action: require survival at a 25-50% spike and re-confirm the rate at every PO

dominance_rules.rule: A flagged soft input dominates a confident downstream verdict built on it
dominance_rules.rationale: the verdict cannot be more certain than its un-cross-examined CAC/returns/repeat spine
dominance_rules.trigger: the verdict is stated at higher confidence than its softest load-bearing input
dominance_rules.action: cap the verdict's confidence at the spine's and name the live-test confirmation path

anti_rework_rules.rule: Establish contribution after CAC as the metric before quoting any margin figure
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a gross-margin-based viability claim that must be fully re-argued once contribution is applied

anti_rework_rules.rule: Carry the corrected cotton 16.5% and real repeat ~1.2x from the first article read
anti_rework_rules.prevents: every downstream per-article and LTV:CAC figure inheriting a discredited duty or repeat that must be re-derived

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confine A2 to a bundle-filler role at the moment its negative single-unit read is stated
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a value-led plan built on standalone A2 that must be torn up after the loss is found

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set the required ~$120-150 AOV when the bundle lever is introduced, not after pricing
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a single-$55-sweater line plan that must be re-priced once the AOV requirement surfaces

anti_rework_rules.rule: Tag every money/duty/CAC claim FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN as it is written
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a later honesty sweep that must re-caveat figures already stated as facts

anti_rework_rules.rule: Sequence the organic probe + paid test before the bulk-inventory PO in the workflow
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a cash-stranding bulk buy made before the demand signal that the tests would have supplied

anti_rework_rules.rule: Make funding the working-capital cycle a binding GO condition the first time the cash trap is named
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a GO issued on per-order economics that must be retracted once the unfunded cash gap is recognised

anti_rework_rules.rule: Hand off the verdict GO-only-qualified with the spine-fragility flag attached
anti_rework_rules.prevents: T10 acting on an unqualified GO that must be re-issued once the un-cross-examined spine is re-surfaced

iteration_protocol.trigger: a live blended-CAC reading (paid-ad test or organic-traction probe) lands
iteration_protocol.action: harden or collapse the CAC governor and re-issue the verdict and conditions at updated confidence

iteration_protocol.trigger: a first-cohort returns or repeat rate is measured
iteration_protocol.action: replace the 25-30% returns / ~1.2x repeat estimates with measured figures and re-grade the per-article read and LTV:CAC

iteration_protocol.trigger: the India surcharge rate changes or Section 122 sunsets / Section 301 resolves
iteration_protocol.action: re-size landed COGS, re-run the spike stress-test, and re-issue the verdict

iteration_protocol.trigger: the T4 knit+LINK job-work rate or a forwarder FCL/LCL quote tightens landed COGS
iteration_protocol.action: narrow the landed bands and re-run the per-article and break-even reads

iteration_protocol.trigger: a working-capital funding determination is made
iteration_protocol.action: resolve the funded/unfunded GO condition and re-issue the verdict's cash-gap point of death

iteration_protocol.trigger: a commission-only affiliate / TikTok-Shop channel is tested for take-up
iteration_protocol.action: re-weight the channel mix toward $0-upfront acquisition and re-evaluate the optimistic flip-conditions

iteration_protocol.trigger: a naming/likeness or creator campaign is proposed
iteration_protocol.action: re-fire the right-of-publicity/Lanham marks-clearance flag before any print or post

iteration_protocol.trigger: the fixed monthly nut or the bundle/AOV configuration changes
iteration_protocol.action: recompute break-even orders/mo and re-state the reachable-volume condition

priority_rationale: The gross-margin trap and contribution governor are foundational because the whole verdict turns on substituting contribution after CAC for gross margin; CAC-as-governor and the duty inversion are the demand- and cost-side spines feeding the per-article read; the per-article read drives the leading-with-A2 danger and the AOV/bundle rescue; the de-minimis model-flip and surcharge volatility set the operating and forward-cost reality; the cross-examination, working-capital trap and break-even formula qualify and stress the spine; the highest-leverage test, verdict, go/no-go and flip conditions compose the decision; and the legal flags, honesty discipline, T10 hand-off and review loop govern expression and keep the verdict current, so they come last.
